svg.title: Known-best packing of 269 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=269 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-12 rational corner Witness/v2 at 269, promoted to exact rationals by this repository's packing-witness promote, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, same-packing, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.
